info.syllabusName: Phân tích dữ liệu định tính (Qualitative data analysis)
info.description: This course reviews and extends student knowledge of the statistics commonly used in sociology and criminology research. Specifically, the course covers: The organization of qualitative data, Methods for summarizing and/or describing qualitative data, the appropriate method to analyze qualitative data. Beyond qualitative data analysis, this course deals with issues related to research methods.
